content:
Subject: Approval for Deferment of price Adjustment for Slippage in Completion - Up to 80% of Nominal Contract Value Without BG Submission for WP-14 package being executed
Name of the work Miscellaneous civil works underground piping for pipe rack and allied areas) warehouse and associated involving piling, civil, structural and EPCM units (GDS, HCU, interconnecting and design supply & construction of works of Petrochemical and Lube
11\. The PMC has ensured that sufficient funds shall be made available in case of future defaults or applicability of price reduction in future. 12\. The agency shall furnish utilisation of the PRS deferment amount in the prescribed format on fortnightly basis with In view of the above, it is proposed for i) Deferment of price adjustment beyond contractual completion date without submission of any BG against price adjustment, for billing up to 80% of the nominal contract value of WP-14 package Submitted for approval please.
summary:
This text is a formal proposal seeking approval to defer price adjustments (penalties) for delays in the completion of the **WP-14 package**. This package involves miscellaneous civil works, underground piping, piling, and structural construction for petrochemical and lube units.

The key points are:

*   **Financial Relief:** The proposal requests that price adjustments for project slippage be deferred without requiring the contractor to submit a Bank Guarantee (BG).
*   **Scope:** This deferment applies to billing up to **80% of the nominal contract value**.
*   **Risk Mitigation:** The Project Management Consultant (PMC) has confirmed that sufficient funds are available to cover potential future defaults or price reductions.
*   **Accountability:** The executing agency is required to submit fortnightly reports in a prescribed format detailing how the deferred funds are being utilized.

In summary, the document outlines a mechanism to ease the contractor's cash flow by delaying penalties for project delays, provided specific reporting and financial safeguards are maintained.
